description.value: H&P Noodle House is a Vietnamese restaurant on Hastings Street in Burnaby serving a broad menu that spans pho, vermicelli, sizzling plates, Thai dishes, and stir-fry. The restaurant offers indoor seating and an integrated online ordering system for pickup and delivery. It is one of two Lower Mainland locations, with a second branch in Port Coquitlam.
